_help: A-24 farming and A-25 ranching (scripts/Farm.cs, scripts/Ranch.cs). Farming: in build mode Interact on a 'till' block with air above makes farmland (overworld only, outside town zones). A seed is the pack item of a crop block (data/blocks.json crop_*): place it on farmland like any block. A crop grows through stages 0..3 over 'grow' seconds of play time (the hero's played clock, so it also grows while its chunk is not loaded); watered soil (water within water.range blocks, or rain above water.rainAt) grows water.mul times as fast, and the farming skill's farmGrowP adds to it. Interact on a ripe crop harvests it: 'yield' produce (+1 by the farming perk farmYieldChance) and 'seeds' seeds; 'regrow' crops (bushes) stay and go back to stage 'regrowStage', the others are replanted at stage 0 with one of the seeds if 'replant' is true. Digging a crop gives its seed back (and the harvest if it was ripe). xp = farming XP. seedDrops: wild = seeds from gathering a wild plant (gather material -> seed block, chance), 'any' = a random field seed from any herb node; mobs = chance per monster kill; chests = seeds in a treasure chest. shop = what the merchant asks for one seed (gold).

ranch._help: A-25 ranching (scripts/Ranch.cs). Livestock (the animals of the pets / animals system, kinds below) follow a hero who carries their favourite 'food' and presses Interact on them (lead; again to stop), for leadTime seconds within leadRange. An animal standing inside a closed fenced area (flood fill from its cell bounded by fences, closed gates and walls, at most penMax cells) becomes yours with that pen as its home and stays in it. Feeding two grown animals of one kind in the same pen (Interact with the food, one unit each) within loveTime seconds and breedRange metres makes a baby that grows up after growTime seconds; each parent then waits breedCooldown. 'produce' is ready every 'every' seconds (up to 'max' waiting) and is collected with Interact. Times are seconds of play time.
